description: This file contains functions related to validating and manipulating boot configuration files for Qualcomm-based devices. It includes functions for checking magic numbers, extracting partition information, and setting primary boot flags.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Checks if the provided file has valid start and end magic numbers for a boot configuration.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions from the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Gets the index of a specified partition based on its name.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Retrieves the primary boot partition index for a given partition name.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag for a specific partition.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Switches the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a given partition.
